task: Prairie lowered horizon, distant matte and textured foreground shade

userProcessPreference.instruction: Prioritize horizon composition, detailed landscape continuation and textured foreground shadow framing across environment art work.
userProcessPreference.status: Explicit user process requirement, recorded in AGENTS.md and existing Lab policy; no biome or candidate approval inferred.
userProcessPreference.application: Evaluate these relationships in every biome; do not automatically add mountains, canopy shadows, mattes or the same camera in all scenes.

implementation: Higher camera aim lowers the horizon in the frame. Eye remains at 1.7m; original terrain and vegetation positions retained.
Generated low rolling-hill matte integrated behind actual terrain; no mountains or named geographic features inferred. Hidden above 30m and when asset is unavailable.

Existing ground-composition lighting installer exposed and extended with an optional grayscale shadow texture. Same world-space field applied to terrain and understory. Original untextured defaults unchanged.
Dedicated soft shadow mask replaces failed regular plant-atlas patterns. Physical directional tree shadows retained separately.

assets.limitations: Illustrated artistic continuation, not observed topography; forward-facing encounter matte, not a global 360 panorama.

assets.method: Built-in image_gen, project-generated grayscale canopy shadow mask
assets.limitations: Art-directed world-space supplementary shade, not a measured shadow map. No exact seamless-edge guarantee claimed.

visualReview.reviewer: Primary Codex actual asset, hero, elevated and comparison image inspection
observations: Horizon moves lower and the wide view has more sky and visibly layered golden/cool distant hills.
Textured foreground shade produces a darker frame around the warm open middle.
Elevated view no longer shows rows of plant-shaped shadow stamps; the matte is hidden and physical terrain remains continuous.
Backdrop is still an illustrated supplement; foreground plant forms and shadow strength remain subject to art direction.

rejections.reason: Matte was occluded; regular plant-atlas shadow grid visible from above.
Warps retained a mechanical pattern, and matte clearance remained insufficient.

validation.targetedShaderTest: passed: texture opt-in, unchanged default sampler behavior and world-space field
validation.comparisonNote: Camera aim deliberately changed under user instruction; this is not a fixed-camera lighting-only comparison. Seed, eye, FOV and render settings retained.

pugetRegression.scope: Shared renderer before/after; approved Puget encounter camera, seed 29, wind off.

validation.fullProtectedSuite: Not run; Puget pixel regression and default shader behavior checked.
